verdict.rationale: A public pricing page exists and lists features such as AI meeting summary, transcription, action items, Ask Fellow, keyword tracking and transcript redaction, and the docs mention an Enterprise plan. That is only a glancing sign of tier transparency: nothing shows actual prices, which tier adds what, or whether basic use avoids a sales wall. Missing for 10: evidence of a free tier or free start, per-tier dollar prices, a tier-by-tier feature breakdown, confirmation that non-Enterprise plans are self-serve without contacting sales, and independent corroboration.
